capabilities: Colors volume, chapter and section heading lines
Highlights book titles, quotes and bracket pairs inline
Tints meta key–value pairs, ordinals and dates
Skips code fences and keeps bare URLs one color
Lets users override each color token per light and dark theme
disambiguation: Not a tool for marking or annotating text; it only colors the syntax of Chinese-structured Markdown.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); mobile is not tested. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+. Colors are applied with !important inline styles so they win over Obsidian's default Markdown coloring. Line-level matching rules and colors are editable in settings.
motivation: Built for Chinese-structured writing such as novels and reading notes, where default syntax highlighting is too coarse.
problem: Obsidian's default Markdown coloring is too coarse for long-form Chinese notes, so chapter headings, book titles, quotes and meta pairs all look alike.
summary: Structural syntax highlighter that colors Chinese chapter headings, book titles, quotes, meta pairs and dates in Reading view and Live Preview.
